text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose that will do for now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, how was it?
El's debut race?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Are you shocked?! Astonished?!
Do I have the makings of a champion, or what?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! Thank you very much-!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still... it's only her maiden flight, after all, YES.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is this all El-El's power amounts to!? No way!
I'm gonna keep getting stronger and stronger from here on out!

Even after pulling off a splendid debut,
El Condor Pasa still seemed to be looking
far, far higher.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, that was a splendid run.
Your talent was overflowing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it~ it's so dynamic.
Like, after she storms past, not even a blade of grass is left standing.”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass! Sei-chan! That's right, yes!
Slowpokes get spankings from behind, deesu!

Their conversation seems to mesh, yet somehow doesn't.
But maybe they still understand each other.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you keep this up, you'll be ready to give it
your all in the Classics too, El-chan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The Classics...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*, there is something I must say
to Trainer-san and everyone here."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It is... about El's future, YES!
Please don't do a backflip out of sheer surprise,
okay?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I, El Condor Pasa, the Wonder Bird of the World—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm NOT entering the Classics!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhhhk!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Not running in the Classics...
How could that even be possible!?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Looks exhausting, so I wanna slack off," maybe?
Hey, that kind of thing is my trademark, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey El, are you being totally, completely serious?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I-I may have said too much... It's not that
she definitely won't participate. Just...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I will not make the Classics my goal!
Because El's goal is not 'the strongest of the generation',
but 'the strongest in the world'!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
While everyone else is aiming for the Triple Crown,
what I'm aiming for is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Conquering the Japan Cup in the Classic year,"
yes!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhhhk!?

"Conquering the Japan Cup in the Classic year."
The sheer difficulty of that is unimaginable.

Her body hasn't fully matured yet,
and yet she must take on the world's best Senior-class competitors.
"Then again, it feels just like El Condor Pasa. Conquering the Japan Cup early on is the fastest way to get the world in her sights."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. El Condor Pasa-san is walking
a different path from ours—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I feel a little lonely, but still...~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, everyone has their own goals~ As long as they're doing well, I think it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even if our paths diverge,
we remain rivals.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us quietly accept this and see them off.
Believing that someday, our paths will cross again.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, bueno...! Bueno...!
Everyone's kindness is soaking in like a waterfall...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, exactly! Even if our paths differ,
we are amigaaaas! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

The voices of their five pledges ring loud and clear into the sky.
From here, El Condor Pasa
âwill soar into a sky of her own.
And so, just the two of us decided on the next target race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: As for our next goal, it's already decided!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's the Japan Cuuuup!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué? Really? El's heart
was already soaring through the autumn sky...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If not the Japan Cup,
where are we going first?

"In the Classic Year, there are two royal roads.
Namely, the 'Triple Crown route' and the 'Tiara route.'"

If she doesn't want either of them, it makes
choosing tough. Asking for her preference—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mmm-, nothin' in particular, no!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's just that El doesn't know... that much about next year's Classic tier...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I prefer something that isn't so hectic, like early in the new year, YES. And at a distance that's not too long, not too short.

So it's right in the "middle" of everything, huh?
Then somewhere between January after the new year
and March, right before the Classics...

The distance is roughly between a 1600m mile
and a 2000m medium distance. In that case...
choice_data_list: How about the Kyodo News Hai next February?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"February! It is the end of winter, yes?
It is just the right time to prepare for spring!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, not too long, not too short!
It's best, just right, and all-around perfect!
"It's right around a middle distance, so it might be ideal for gauging aptitude."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled!
Next up is the Kyodo News Hai, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Until then, let's do tons and tons
of races, training, and meetings!"
